comparison.objective: Fasten a screw through an upright plate into a coupling nut held on the far side.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually align separate screw and nut, hold the nut against rotation, catch the thread, and turn the screw until snug.
comparison.success_condition: The screw passes through the plate, engages for at least 1.5 turns, and leaves both head and nut snug after release.
comparison.reason: This is the closest generic fastening primitive, but it creates a new screw-nut joint to a snug endpoint; the candidate preserves an existing adjustable stop against jam-nut reaction and must prove its setting through repeated actuation.
